title: passiflora foetida var. hastata
intro: Passiflora foetida var. hastata, commonly known as Yellow Passion Flower, is a plant species within the Passifloraceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat a variety of health conditions, including anxiety and insomnia, due to its sedative and calming properties. The bioactive constituents of Yellow Passion Flower include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Passiflora foetida var. hastata also include sedation, anxiolysis, and muscle relaxation, making it a potential herbal remedy for stress relief and promoting a good night's sleep.
